title: OAuth 2.1 authorization
objective: Implement standards-based OAuth 2.1 authorization for remote principal identity against the frozen SG-000052 relay contract and the SG-000053 device identity without granting workspace trust, approval, presence, or capability authority: authorization code with PKCE S256, protected-resource metadata, authorization-server metadata, resource binding, issuer verification, signature verification, audience validation, expiry and not-before enforcement, scopes, token revocation, refresh family controls with fresh device-key proof, provider client-identification hooks, and the default-deny scope to tool ceiling mapping.

include: OAuth 2.1 authorization code flow with PKCE S256
resource binding, issuer verification, signature verification, and audience validation
expiry and not-before enforcement, scopes, and token revocation
refresh family controls requiring fresh device-key proof so a stolen refresh token cannot renew forever while the bound device is offline
provider client-identification hooks reverified against current provider requirements before provider-specific work
default-deny normative mapping from OAuth scopes to tool and profile ceilings with unknown mapping denied
exclude: any device uplink networking beyond the frozen contract vocabulary (SG-000055)
any new local MCP tool, tool schema change, capability widening, or approval change
any workspace trust, local approval, local presence, or local capability authority derived from OAuth alone
any P16 tool-surface widening or provider submission
any public provider submission, directory publication, or availability claim

authority_delta.network: None beyond the OAuth metadata and token validation vocabulary defined here; no listener and no proxy.
authority_delta.secrets: OAuth token material is validated transiently and never logged; no new secret class is exposed to tools.

invariants: OAuth proves remote principal identity and nothing else
unknown scope mapping denies by default
a stolen refresh token cannot renew forever while the bound device is offline
the SG-000052 frame, envelope, failure, and bound vocabulary stays frozen
the SG-000053 device identity, pairing, revocation, and envelope binding stays frozen

acceptance.claim: OAuth 2.1 authorization code with PKCE S256, metadata, resource binding, issuer, signature, audience, expiry, scope, revocation, and refresh family controls works with fresh device-key proof.
Default-deny scope to tool ceiling mapping denies unknown scopes and OAuth alone grants no workspace trust, approval, presence, or capability.
Negative tests prove expired, revoked, wrong-audience, wrong-resource, and stolen-refresh cases fail closed without local dispatch.
Exact-head CI including release qualification and supply-chain audit, genuine TypeSafe Jev, Alibaba Open Code Review, manual review of excluded files, and zero unresolved review threads all pass.

successor_requirements.sg_000055: Outbound-only device uplink may proceed only after SG-000054 closes with OAuth 2.1 authorization qualified.

done_when: OAuth 2.1 authorization is canonical with default-deny scope ceilings and no authority beyond remote principal identity.
